reason: The README describes an LLM adapter that integrates DeepSeek Harness with an OpenAI ChatGPT subscription using OAuth and a local Codex CLI login, so external-services is the primary category.

summaries.zh: 通过 OAuth 将 DeepSeek Harness 连接到 OpenAI ChatGPT 订阅，并复用本地 Codex CLI 登录信息。
summaries.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to an OpenAI ChatGPT subscription through OAuth and reuses local Codex CLI login information.

capabilities: Connects DeepSeek Harness to OpenAI ChatGPT through OAuth
Reuses a local Codex CLI authentication file at ~/.codex/auth.json
Provides model selection and login through DeepSeek Harness settings
